name: generative-learning
title: Self-explanation, Worked Example and Completion Problem
description: Three related learning components: an ungraded SelfExplanationPrompt with post-submit model comparison, a static or progressively disclosed WorkedExample, and a CompletionProblem with worked/missing steps, partial results and informative per-step feedback. Includes controlled/uncontrolled APIs, localization, partial/empty/disabled states and accessible native form controls.
